name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.72.0: Install nRF52 radios over BLE through their DFU bootloader; Leave the on-screen keyboard grid out of a desktop window; Move About radio and Radio actions onto the Radio tab; App icon for the macOS and Windows installs; Ship a macOS .dmg and a Windows installer; Install updates on macOS and Windows (and 102 more).
changelog.v2.71.1: Two more places the environment prefix and the catalog were missed; Build clean under clang, which the sanitizer job uses.
changelog.v2.71.0: Fetch over HTTPS in-process instead of forking curl; An HTTP/1.1 codec for fetching in-process; Verify against CA roots compiled into the binary; Open a node's detail on the node, not on its verbs; Clear a channel slot rather than only disabling it; Keep a measured route per node, on the card (and 108 more).
changelog.v2.70.0: Measure a press to the panel, and close step 3 of the map; Walk the node detail by card, and stop promising presses it does not have; Time only presses that changed the frame, and stop the client on a failed run.
changelog.v2.69.2: Stop a read conversation rewriting the cache on every update.
